title: Boston Harbor Sunset Sail Tour
includes: This is a 2 hour sailing experience in Boston Harbor.
This is not a narrated tour, but the crew is available to answer questions on the sights & landmarks
Beverages are not included, but are available for purchase by credit card
Gratuities (recommended for the captain and crew) (not included)
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels
Children must be accompanied by an adult
Minimum drinking age is 21 years. Coolers and outside alcoholic beverages are not permitted
policies: Dress for the weather - it's often cooler on the water
Please let us know in advance if assistance is required for boarding
Only animals that perform a manual task to assist a person are permitted aboard. Emotional support animals and pets are not permitted

Plan to arrive at the ticket booth 15-30 minutes prior to the departure time. The meeting point is located directly behind the Boston Harbor Hotel in the Ferry Terminal just steps away from the dock. Boarding begins 5 minutes prior to the scheduled departure time.
This is not a narrated tour, but the crew is available to answer questions on the sights & landmarks as we sail
This experience will take place on Schooner Adirondack II or III
The official route of this experience will depend on the wind
Large group bookings are not permitted. Multiple bookings are subject to added fees or cancellation by operator
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Experience a beautiful Boston Harbor sunset sail on the water and see some of the city's waterfront landmarks as the sun dips below the horizon. This elegant sailing experience will be aboard either Schooner Adirondack III or Adirondack IV. Both sailboats are classically styled schooners and offer a smooth and gentle sailing experience as well as top-notch customer service by our captain and crew. Within minutes of leaving the dock, you'll forget the distractions of life on land, as you experience the ambiance of a sunset sailing cruise aboard a beautiful sailboat.
